cross_references.relationship: procedural successor — §10123.135 governs the prior authorization decision; §1374.30 governs the mandatory external review available when that decision is adverse. The two statutes form the complete denial-and-appeal procedural framework for California health care coverage disputes.

authority source — §1374.30 operates within the Knox-Keene regulatory framework; DMHC's authority to establish and enforce IMR derives from Knox-Keene; health plans subject to §1340/§1367 are the entities subject to IMR obligations
